'''Labor Outpost''' was a settlement on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

==Characteristics==
The outpost was little more than a small, enclosed settlement. However, unlike the [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] [[Mining Outpost (Yavin 4)|Mining Outpost]], it had a sturdier perimeter and a large watch tower. It also had its own [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], medical center, and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="AED" />

==History==
This outpost was established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after capturing Yavin 4 from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The outpost was popular among [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], who operated out of it frequently.<ref name="AED" />

Some notable residents of the outpost during this time included [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] [[Aqzow]], [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Eker]], and [[Wuioe Opca]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Labor Outpost is one of three small outposts on Yavin 4 in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' that has its own spaceport. The other two settlements that have a spaceport in the game are the Mining Outpost and the [[Imperial Fortress (Yavin 4)|Imperial Fortress]].
